about: User agents and the answer every adapter of the Meta in-app browser gate must give for each: detect.ts, the SvelteKit gate, the interstitial's own script and MiConnect's nginx map. The in-app ones are the shapes Meta's apps send (tokens matter; versions are realistic padding); the Threads ones are as reported, unmeasured here. The rest must NEVER match: Meta's link-preview crawler and fetchers (blocking them blanks every preview card), other unfurlers, real browsers and the Canari app's own WebView.
